set_aside.subject: A03 scratch file-size limit outcome
set_aside.text: “The runner ignores the signal the host sends for a write past it, so the write fails with an error the code can see” contradicts “a limit hit (memory, process count, scratch, `output_bytes`) — `resource_exhausted`” when the code catches that error and returns conforming outputs.
set_aside.question: How must the runner detect and remember that the scratch file-size limit was hit so the execution is classified `resource_exhausted` even when agent code catches the write error?
options: Install a signal handler that records the hit before allowing the write to fail
Instrument or mediate scratch writes and record an over-limit attempt
Treat a caught file-size error as no recorded limit hit, allowing another outcome or success
set_aside.default_guess: Install a runner-controlled signal handler that records the hit and then classify the execution `resource_exhausted`.
